dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Pronounced, symmetrical 2D narrowing originating from the mid-section and tapering sharply toward the posterior extremity.
dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.planar_edge_undulation: Lateral margins exhibit smooth, continuous curvature without observable bulges or indentations.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: Slate dark-grey; uniform median pixel intensity across the entire visible dorsal surface with minimal specular interference.

high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.localized_point_contrast_disruptions: A narrow, high-contrast light-colored linear feature is visible extending along the sagittal dorsal ridge.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Distinct, light-colored linear mark or scar localized along the mid-dorsal axis.
